title: Emma Bloomberg Associate Professor of Public Policy
affiliation: Emma Bloomberg Associate Professor of Public Policy
bio: Justin de Benedictis-Kessner is the Emma Bloomberg Associate Professor of Public Policy at the Kennedy School of Government at Harvard University. His research focuses on urban politics and policy. His work investigates how politics shapes and is shaped by some of the most important policy areas that concern local governments, such as housing, transportation, policing, and economic development.
